changelog:
v1.25.8 - Playtest fixes — Borsello defense readout + Scudo MDMA shield VFX: (1) the damage-taken HUD chip now reads as a positive **"Damage Reduction: +XX%"** instead of the confusing "Defense: -XX%" (sign flipped for both the chip total and the per-source hover tooltip, covering the multiplicative `dmg_taken_mult` and additive `dmg_reduction` sources). (2) The Scudo MDMA shield no longer renders as a "solid blue" ball: a leftover emissive `_shield_dome` (StandardMaterial3D sphere, radius 1.2) was overlapping and occluding the new refractive `PlayerShieldVFX` bubble — only briefly visible in the one-frame gap as `shield_hp` hit 0. Removed the dome entirely, redirected the per-hit red flash to pulse the bubble's `energy_color` (new `Player._flash_shield_hit`), nudged the bubble's `core_opacity` 0.45→0.30 for the requested extra transparency, and made the shader material `resource_local_to_scene` so the flash only tints the player's own bubble. Generator (`tools/build_effects.gd`) updated to match the hand-edited scene. Verified: clean headless `--import` + `test_powers`/`test_balance` pass.
v1.25.7 - HUD overhaul + low-health feedback systems: (1) a floating player health bar above the player — identical build/styling to the enemy bars — that mirrors HP and auto-hides via an opacity fade (shown below 100% HP or for 3s after a hit); (2) a red peripheral screen vignette that fades in below 33% HP and pulses faster/brighter as HP approaches 0 (new `shaders/vignette_low_hp.gdshader`); (3) below 20% HP a synthesized looping heartbeat plus a low-pass "shock" muffle on a dedicated music bus, both eased in/out; (4) relocated the minimap to the top-right corner with the Cash/Kills counters stacked right-aligned beneath it — all corner-anchored so the HUD scales across resolutions. SoundManager gains a Music bus + runtime heartbeat synth. Verified: full headless PlayScene boot clean + dedicated assertions.
v1.25.6 - Player survivability pass (poison/DoT + rolling): all damage-over-time the player takes is now centrally rate-capped in `take_damage` — per type ≤ max_hp/30 per sec and all DoT combined ≤ max_hp/10 per sec (token buckets), and DoT can never deal the killing blow (it floors at 1 HP). Rolling now shakes off stun/slow/freeze (DoT and damage-reduction are kept), and a roll grants full invulnerability to hits, area effects and incoming debuffs for its duration (`apply_stun`/`apply_slow` and the status gate now respect `is_rolling`).
